sources.entry: Dissolv - Hide and close inactive apps. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/dissolv/id1640893012?platform=mac)

summary.name: Dissolv
summary.one_liner: Dissolv is a Mac app that hides applications you are not using so background window clutter stays out of the way.
use_cases: hide applications you are not currently using
reduce distractions while working on a Mac
auto-hide apps after a period of inactivity
set different hide rules for specific apps
summary.what_it_does: Dissolv hides applications that have not been activated for a set period, which clears background window clutter as you work. You can set one global time after which all applications are hidden. You can also set custom settings for specific applications. The page is a short product description with contact details and no detailed feature list. It is listed in the awesome-mac list under Window Management, described as hiding and closing inactive apps.
notable: Global inactivity timer that hides all apps after a set period
Listed on the Mac App Store
caveats: The page does not state pricing or whether there is a free tier
The page does not describe any limitations
